independent_methods: Weighted AP from descending tied score groups; weighted ROC AUC from positive-negative pair mass including half-credit ties; Brier by direct weighted squared error; top5% by score-group fractional capacity. Manual preprocessing transform and training-only weighted empirical quantiles, no trainer evaluation or preprocessing functions called. Serialized estimators used only for inference.
required_interpretive_warnings: tuning_train: only 3 positive filing windows; count is not independent events, tuning/metrics can be unstable
validation: only 7 positive filing windows; count is not independent events, tuning/metrics can be unstable
Conditional design uncertainty does not quantify training/tuning variability; sparse early-fold tuning must not be described as stable or robust.
Same CIKs may recur over time by design; historical labels mature before each fitting cutoff, but this is temporal rather than unseen-company validation.
B is a future-vintage diagnostic; recomputation does not establish deployability, historical API authenticity, or completeness of legal bankruptcy labels.
